metadata.description: SPECT Step 2 Tc-99m attenuation reference data. Narrow-beam NIST XCOM data only; not a practical broad-beam shielding dataset and not approved for production calculation.

provenance.source_organisation: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
provenance.reference_id: Hubbell and Seltzer, NISTIR 5632; NIST X-Ray Mass Attenuation Coefficients
provenance.table_or_section: Lead (Z=82), tabulated total mass attenuation coefficients at 0.100 and 0.150 MeV
provenance.source_values: mu/rho = 5.549 cm2/g at 0.100 MeV and 2.014 cm2/g at 0.150 MeV; density = 11.35 g/cm3.
provenance.derivation: Log-log interpolation of mu/rho to 0.140511 MeV; mu = (mu/rho)*density; HVL = ln(2)/mu; TVL = ln(10)/mu.
provenance.notes: Narrow-beam exponential attenuation reference only. Scatter/buildup and practical broad-beam shielding transmission are not represented.

provenance.source_title: X-Ray Mass Attenuation Coefficients - Concrete, Ordinary
provenance.source_organisation: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
provenance.reference_id: Hubbell and Seltzer, NISTIR 5632; NIST X-Ray Mass Attenuation Coefficients
provenance.table_or_section: Concrete, Ordinary, tabulated total mass attenuation coefficients at 0.100 and 0.150 MeV; material density from NIST composition table
provenance.source_values: mu/rho = 0.1738 cm2/g at 0.100 MeV and 0.1436 cm2/g at 0.150 MeV; density = 2.300 g/cm3.
provenance.derivation: Log-log interpolation of mu/rho to 0.140511 MeV; mu = (mu/rho)*density; HVL = ln(2)/mu; TVL = ln(10)/mu.
provenance.notes: Narrow-beam exponential attenuation reference only. Concrete density/composition is part of the material identity; practical shielding requires a separately reviewed broad-beam model.
